messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Realtime service (us-west) p99 latency spike detected · rule: realtime.p99 > 2s for 5m · current p95=820ms p99=3.2s · paging @mike_oncall :rotating_light:

mike_oncall: oncall here, joining bridge now. link: https://meet.redwood/invite/abc123

sara_sre: I'm awake, pulling up dashboards (realtime, prefixcache, and infra). starting with p99 heatmap and node-level latencies.

jon_prod: customer impact unknown yet — usage spike from a single tenant? checking slow query logs and streaming tail metrics.

leah_eng: noticed a small rollout 35m ago: kv-cache eviction policy tweak (pr#8745) rolled to us-west canaries -> full rollout 30m ago. might correlate.

mike_oncall: good catch. sara — can you confirm whether kvcache hit-rate dropped around same time?

sara_sre: kvcache hit-rate: was ~85% -> dropped to 62% at 02:18 UTC. prefix-cache eviction spikes at same timestamps.

sara_sre: quick checks: 
```
# probe tail of pods
kubectl -n realtime get pods -l app=realtime -o wide
# top latency pods
kubectl -n realtime exec -it pod/realtime-3 -- curl -s localhost:9000/metrics | grep latency
```

mike_oncall: running the probe now. seeing two pods with 4xx throttle errors and high CPU on g4dn-type nodes.

jon_prod: we have streaming stalls indicated by stalled connections metric. client-side timeouts increased. Could be expensive cold KV misses increasing tokenization work and causing stalls.

nate_support: any customer-facing outages? I can run short query sampling on top 5 tenants to surface errors.

leah_eng: suggestion: rollback kvcache eviction policy to previous config for us-west only (canary rollback) to see impact. If rollback reduces p99, plan full rollback and investigate eviction thresholds.

mike_oncall: agree. Initiating targeted rollback to previous config on the two affected node pools. Command: `deploy rollback realtime-kvcache-config us-west --to=rev-2026-03-16-09`

incident-bot: [ACTION] rollback job created (job id jb-7742). Notifying deploy pipeline. ETA ~90s to config apply.

sara_sre: post-rollback metrics in ~120s. watching p95/p99 and kvcache hit-rate.

mike_oncall: if rollback doesn't improve in 5m, plan: route 30% traffic to dedicated-reserved pool (dedicated1) and enable fallback model variant with smaller context. That reduces pressure and keeps customer latency within SLOs.

jon_prod: adding checklist for follow-ups: 1) correlate rollout diffs + CI perf tests, 2) reproduce in staging with synthetic tail loads, 3) add alert for sudden kvcache hit-rate drops.

nate_support: pinging top 3 customers in affected region: T-1 doing live checks and will update support tickets.

sara_sre: rollback applied. kvcache hit-rate climbing back: 64% -> 81% in last 90s. p99 dropping: 3.2s -> 1.1s. Good signal.

mike_oncall: great. marking incident as mitigated for now. continuing monitoring for 30m. creating follow-up ticket: ENG-INC-2026-1732 for postmortem and config hardening.

leah_eng: adding to postmortem: safer rollout guard for kvcache changes (gradual ramp + synthetic tail smoke tests + automated hit-rate rollback).

jon_prod: notifying product + customer-success with summary. Nate, please update the affected customers: we mitigated by rolling back config; we expect normal behavior resumed and we will follow up with RCA.

nate_support: will update tickets and send a short status to customers now. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: [CLOSE] Incident mitigated · p99 back under threshold · monitoring for 30m · follow-up ENG-INC-2026-1732 created.
